# Frozen pre-BinaryTreeLazy2 Lazy-family baseline

Complete zstdoxide frames and exact allocation survey from the reviewed 2026-10-13 clock-free Lazy-family campaign, before BinaryTreeLazy2 changes. Eighty logical cases include forty-eight Lazy/Lazy2 and thirty-two predecessor controls. All sixteen backends agree. No timing or independent C decode is claimed for these exact frames. Allocation replay is qualified to the recorded target/toolchain.

The separate checker reconstructs all eighty records from the pinned clock-free
archive without running archived or current codec code. The source workload seed,
exact request tuples, complete frames and twelve qualified allocator fields are
preserved. Earlier Fast, DoubleFast and Greedy fixtures remain immutable.
